description: List this account's support tickets, newest first, with their subject, a short preview, open state, and timestamps. Use this before get_ticket or reply_to_ticket to find the right id. Paginate with `cursor`: pass the `next_cursor` from a previous call to fetch the following page.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from the `next_cursor` value returned by a previous call. Omit for the first page.

limit.description: How many tickets to return per page (20-50). Defaults to 20.

name: list_tickets
title: List Support Tickets
